ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; dominant high-intensity central regions (white) contrasted against low-intensity peripheral margins and a vertical median band (black).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central 60% of both lobes. Black pigmentation is concentrated along the entire trailing edge, forming a dense boundary. A vertical black column bisects the fluke at the median notch. Heavy black mottling and stippling are present in the upper-left and upper-right quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a narrow apex; approximate internal angle of 40-50 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing boundary. Left lobe (viewer perspective) exhibits high-amplitude jagged peaks and deep valleys. Right lobe exhibits moderate-frequency, lower-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the distal edges of both lobes, tapering to sharp, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular high-contrast white pixel clusters visible on the outer margin of the right lobe tip and scattered along the black trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear scratches (rake marks) visible across the white central region of the left lobe, including several long parallel marks crossing diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentations and jagged tissue loss along the trailing edge of the left lobe, deviating from a smooth biological curve.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, concentrated black vertical striations localized at the transition zone between the white central region and the black median column.
